artifacts.name: Dwarf Scroll I
artifacts.description: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a red bow.

artifacts.name: Dwarf Scroll II
artifacts.description: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a green ribbon.

artifacts.name: Dwarf Scroll III
artifacts.description: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a blue rope.

artifacts.name: Dwarf Scroll IV
artifacts.description: A yellowed scroll of parchment filled with dwarven script. This one's tied with a golden chain.

artifacts.name: Chipped Amphora
artifacts.description: An ancient vessel made of ceramic material. Used to transport both dry and wet goods.

artifacts.name: Arrowhead
artifacts.description: A crudely fashioned point used for hunting.

artifacts.name: Ancient Doll
artifacts.description: An ancient doll covered in grime. This doll may have been used as a toy, a decoration, or a prop in some kind of ritual.

artifacts.name: Elvish Jewelry
artifacts.description: Dirty but still beautiful. On the side is a flowing script thought by some to be the ancient language of the elves. No Elvish bones have ever been found.

artifacts.name: Chewing Stick
artifacts.description: Ancient people chewed on these to keep their teeth clean.

artifacts.name: Ornamental Fan
artifacts.description: This exquisite fan most likely belonged to a noblewoman. Historians believe that the valley was a popular sixth-era vacation spot for the wealthy.

artifacts.name: Dinosaur Egg
artifacts.description: A giant dino egg... The entire shell is still intact!

artifacts.name: Rare Disc
artifacts.description: A heavy black disc studded with peculiar red stones. When you hold it, you're overwhelmed with a feeling of dread.

artifacts.name: Ancient Sword
artifacts.description: It's the remains of an ancient sword. Most of the blade has turned to rust, but the hilt is very finely crafted.

artifacts.name: Rusty Spoon
artifacts.description: A plain old spoon, probably ten years old. Not very interesting.

artifacts.name: Rusty Spur
artifacts.description: An old spur that was once attached to a cowboy's boot. People must have been raising animals in this area for many generations.

artifacts.name: Rusty Cog
artifacts.description: A well preserved cog that must have been part of some ancient machine. This could be dwarven technology.

artifacts.name: Chicken Statue
artifacts.description: It's a statue of a chicken on a bronze base. The ancient people of this area must have been very fond of chickens.

artifacts.name: Ancient Seed
artifacts.description: It's a dry old seed from some ancient plant. By all appearances it's long since dead...

artifacts.name: Prehistoric Tool
artifacts.description: Some kind of gnarly old digging tool.

artifacts.name: Dried Starfish
artifacts.description: A starfish from the primordial ocean. It's an unusually pristine specimen!

artifacts.name: Anchor
artifacts.description: It may have belonged to ancient pirates.

artifacts.name: Glass Shards
artifacts.description: A mixture of glass shards smoothed by centuries of ocean surf. These could have belonged to an ancient mosaic or necklace.

artifacts.name: Bone Flute
artifacts.description: It's a prehistoric wind instrument carved from an animal's bone. It produces an eerie tone.

artifacts.name: Prehistoric Handaxe
artifacts.description: One of the earliest tools employed by humans. This "crude" tool was created by striking one rock with another to form a sharp edge.

artifacts.name: Dwarvish Helm
artifacts.description: It's one of the helmets commonly worn by dwarves. The thick metal plating protects them from falling debris and stalactites.

artifacts.name: Dwarf Gadget
artifacts.description: It's a piece of the advanced technology once known to the dwarves. It's still glowing and humming, but you're unable to understand how it works.

artifacts.name: Ancient Drum
artifacts.description: It's a drum made from wood and animal skin. It has a low, reverberating tone.

artifacts.name: Golden Mask
artifacts.description: A creepy golden mask probably used in an ancient magic ritual. A socket in the forehead contains a large purple gemstone.

artifacts.name: Golden Relic
artifacts.description: It's a golden slab with hieroglyphs and pictures emblazoned onto the front.

artifacts.name: Prehistoric Scapula
artifacts.description: Commonly known as a "shoulder blade"... It's unclear what species it belonged to.

artifacts.name: Prehistoric Tibia
artifacts.description: A thick and sturdy leg bone.

artifacts.name: Prehistoric Skull
artifacts.description: This is definitely a mammalian skull.

artifacts.name: Skeletal Hand
artifacts.description: It's a wonder all these ancient little pieces lasted so long.

artifacts.name: Prehistoric Rib
artifacts.description: Little gouge marks on the side suggest that this rib was someone's dinner.

artifacts.name: Prehistoric Vertebra
artifacts.description: A segment of some prehistoric creature's spine.

artifacts.name: Skeletal Tail
artifacts.description: It's pretty short for a tail.

artifacts.name: Nautilus Fossil
artifacts.description: This must've washed up ages ago from an ancient coral reef.

artifacts.name: Amphibian Fossil
artifacts.description: The relatively short hind legs suggest some kind of primordial toad.

artifacts.name: Palm Fossil
artifacts.description: Palm Fossils are relatively common, but this happens to be a particularly well-preserved specimen.

artifacts.name: Trilobite
artifacts.description: A long extinct relative of the crab.

foragedMinerals.name: Quartz
foragedMinerals.description: A clear crystal commonly found in caves and mines.

foragedMinerals.name: Earth Crystal
foragedMinerals.description: A resinous substance found near the surface.

foragedMinerals.name: Frozen Tear
foragedMinerals.description: A crystal fabled to be the frozen tears of a yeti.

foragedMinerals.name: Fire Quartz
foragedMinerals.description: A glowing red crystal commonly found near hot lava.

gems.name: Emerald
gems.description: A precious stone with a brilliant green color.

gems.name: Ruby
gems.description: A precious stone that is sought after for its rich color and beautiful luster.

gems.name: Topaz
gems.description: Fairly common but still prized for its beauty.

gems.name: Prismatic Shard
gems.description: A very rare and powerful substance with unknown origins.

geodeMinerals.name: Tigerseye
geodeMinerals.description: A stripe of shimmering gold gives this gem a warm luster.

geodeMinerals.name: Opal
geodeMinerals.description: Its internal structure causes it to reflect a rainbow of light.

geodeMinerals.name: Fire Opal
geodeMinerals.description: A rare variety of opal, named for its red spots.

geodeMinerals.name: Alamite
geodeMinerals.description: Its distinctive fluorescence makes it a favorite among rock collectors.

geodeMinerals.name: Bixite
geodeMinerals.description: A dark metallic Mineral sought after for its cubic structure.

geodeMinerals.name: Baryte
geodeMinerals.description: The best specimens resemble a desert rose.

geodeMinerals.name: Aerinite
geodeMinerals.description: These crystals are curiously light.

geodeMinerals.name: Calcite
geodeMinerals.description: This yellow crystal is speckled with shimmering nodules.

geodeMinerals.name: Dolomite
geodeMinerals.description: It can occur in coral reefs, often near an underwater volcano.

geodeMinerals.name: Esperite
geodeMinerals.description: The crystals glow bright green when stimulated.

geodeMinerals.name: Fluorapatite
geodeMinerals.description: Small amounts are found in human teeth.

geodeMinerals.name: Geminite
geodeMinerals.description: Occurs in brilliant clusters.

geodeMinerals.name: Helvite
geodeMinerals.description: It grows in a triangular column.

geodeMinerals.name: Jamborite
geodeMinerals.description: The crystals are so tightly packed it almost looks fuzzy.

geodeMinerals.name: Jagoite
geodeMinerals.description: A high volume of tiny crystals makes it very glittery.

geodeMinerals.name: Kyanite
geodeMinerals.description: The geometric faces are as smooth as glass.

geodeMinerals.name: Lunarite
geodeMinerals.description: The cratered white orbs form a tight cluster.

geodeMinerals.name: Malachite
geodeMinerals.description: A popular ornamental stone, used in sculpture and to make green paint.

geodeMinerals.name: Neptunite
geodeMinerals.description: A jet-black crystal that is unusually reflective.

geodeMinerals.name: Lemon Stone
geodeMinerals.description: Some claim the powdered crystal is a dwarvish delicacy.

geodeMinerals.name: Nekoite
geodeMinerals.description: The delicate shards form a tiny pink meadow.

geodeMinerals.name: Orpiment
geodeMinerals.description: Despite its high toxicity, this Mineral is widely used in manufacturing and folk medicine.

geodeMinerals.name: Petrified Slime
geodeMinerals.description: This little guy may be 100,000 years old.

geodeMinerals.name: Thunder Egg
geodeMinerals.description: According to legend, angry thunder spirits would throw these stones at one another.

geodeMinerals.name: Pyrite
geodeMinerals.description: Commonly known as "Fool's Gold".

geodeMinerals.name: Ocean Stone
geodeMinerals.description: An old legend claims these stones are the mosaics of ancient mermaids.

geodeMinerals.name: Ghost Crystal
geodeMinerals.description: There is an aura of coldness around this crystal.

geodeMinerals.name: Jasper
geodeMinerals.description: When polished, this stone becomes attractively luminous. Prized by ancient peoples for thousands of years.

geodeMinerals.name: Celestine
geodeMinerals.description: Some early life forms had bones made from this.

geodeMinerals.name: Marble
geodeMinerals.description: A very popular material for sculptures and construction.

geodeMinerals.name: Sandstone
geodeMinerals.description: A common type of stone with red and brown striations.

geodeMinerals.name: Granite
geodeMinerals.description: A speckled Mineral that is commonly used in construction.

geodeMinerals.name: Basalt
geodeMinerals.description: Forms near searing hot magma.

geodeMinerals.name: Limestone
geodeMinerals.description: A very common type of stone. It's not worth very much.

geodeMinerals.name: Soapstone
geodeMinerals.description: Because of its relatively soft consistency, this stone is very popular for carving.

geodeMinerals.name: Hematite
geodeMinerals.description: An iron-based Mineral with interesting magnetic properties.

geodeMinerals.name: Mudstone
geodeMinerals.description: A fine-grained rock made from ancient clay or mud.

geodeMinerals.name: Obsidian
geodeMinerals.description: A volcanic glass that forms when lava cools rapidly.

geodeMinerals.name: Slate
geodeMinerals.description: It's extremely resistant to water, making it a good roofing material.

geodeMinerals.name: Fairy Stone
geodeMinerals.description: An old miner's song suggests these are made from the bones of ancient fairies.

geodeMinerals.name: Star Shards
geodeMinerals.description: No one knows how these form. Some scientists claim that the microscopic structure displays unnatural regularity.

geodes.name: Geode
geodes.description: A blacksmith can break this open for you.

geodes.name: Frozen Geode
geodes.description: A blacksmith can break this open for you.

geodes.name: Magma Geode
geodes.description: A blacksmith can break this open for you.

geodes.name: Omni Geode
geodes.description: A blacksmith can break this open for you. These geodes contain a wide variety of minerals.
